title: 老鼋问旧诺
subtitle: 忘记的承诺，也要认真补上
origin: 《西游记》第九十九回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 答应别人的事要记下来；真的忘了，就诚实道歉并想办法补救。
moral.en: Write down your promises; if you truly forget, apologize honestly and make amends.

pages.zh: 归途中，师徒又来到通天河。老鼋从水里探出头，欢喜地来接他们过河。
pages.en: On the way home, the travelers returned to the River of Heaven. The old turtle surfaced happily to carry them across.
pages.prompt: Create Old Turtle anchor: a very large gentle river turtle with a rounded moss-green shell patterned with soft golden swirls, warm olive skin, large kind amber eyes, and two short silver whiskers; friendly and sturdy, never monstrous. He surfaces beside the established travelers at a calm broad river.

pages.zh: 走到河心，老鼋问：“多年前托你们问的那件事，可有答案？”
pages.en: At midstream, the old turtle asked, "Did you find an answer to the question I entrusted to you years ago?"
pages.prompt: The established team sits safely on Old Turtle's broad rounded shell at midstream; Old Turtle turns his kind face slightly to ask a question, calm water and open sky.

pages.zh: 唐僧一下愣住了。他们一路忙着过难关，竟把老鼋的托付忘得干干净净。
pages.en: Tang Seng froze. Through all their trials, they had completely forgotten the old turtle's request.
pages.prompt: Tang Seng looks honestly startled and remorseful while Wukong, Bajie, and Sha exchange thoughtful glances on Old Turtle's stable shell; no shame spectacle or fear.

pages.zh: 八戒想编个答案，悟空轻轻拉住他：“不知道就是不知道，不能用猜的补承诺。”
pages.en: Bajie started to invent an answer, but Wukong gently stopped him. "If we do not know, we must not patch a promise with a guess."
pages.prompt: Wukong gently touches Bajie's sleeve before he speaks, both seated safely; Sha and Tang Seng listen, Old Turtle remains calm; friendly correction, no scolding.

pages.zh: 唐僧郑重道歉，说明自己没有问到答案，也不该一直不提。
pages.en: Tang Seng apologized sincerely, explaining that he had not asked—and should not have stayed silent about it.
pages.prompt: Tang Seng bows carefully while seated on Old Turtle's shell, hands joined in sincere apology; Old Turtle listens with kind but disappointed eyes, gentle dusk light.

pages.zh: 老鼋有些失望，壳边轻轻一歪。大家滑进浅浅的沙洲，只有鞋袜和经包外布沾了水。
pages.en: The old turtle was disappointed and tilted his shell slightly. Everyone slid onto a shallow sandbar; only shoes and the outer scripture cloth got wet.
pages.prompt: Child-safe comic moment: Old Turtle gently tilts near a broad shallow sandbar, and the established travelers slide a very short distance into ankle-deep sparkling water while holding scripture cases above water; no panic, deep water, or injury.

pages.zh: 师徒没有责怪老鼋。他们一起把经包搬上岸，还把承诺写在随身的小册子里。
pages.en: The travelers did not blame the old turtle. They carried the cases ashore together and recorded the promise in a small notebook.
pages.prompt: On a sunny sandbar, the established team safely carries dry scripture cases ashore; Tang Seng marks a small notebook with abstract non-readable strokes while Old Turtle watches nearby.

pages.zh: 老鼋把他们送到对岸。分别前，唐僧说：“有了答案，我一定托可靠的人带给你。”
pages.en: The old turtle brought them to the far bank. Tang Seng promised, "When I have the answer, I will send it through someone dependable."
pages.prompt: The established travelers thank Old Turtle at the far bank; Tang Seng holds the closed notebook to his heart, Old Turtle smiles gently, restored trust at sunrise.
